question.q: Which is the best translation of '如果明天下雨，我們就改在室內舉行活動' ?
question.correct: If it rains tomorrow, we will hold the event indoors.
wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we held the event indoors yesterday.
Although it rains tomorrow, we did not hold the event.
Because tomorrow is sunny, we will cancel the event.
question.exp: 未來真實條件句 if 子句用現在式，主要子句用 will；並保留改在室內之意。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Choose the best translation: '這本書不但容易理解，而且提供許多實用例子。'
question.correct: This book is not only easy to understand but also full of practical examples.
wrong: This book is not easy to understand and gives no examples.
This book is neither useful nor understandable.
The book was lost because it had many pages.
question.exp: not only ... but also ... 表不但且，正確選項保留易懂與實例多兩個訊息。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Choose the best translation of「雖然這項計畫降低了初期成本，但仍須考慮後續維護費用。」
question.correct: Although the plan reduced initial costs, future maintenance expenses still need to be considered.
wrong: Because the plan increased initial costs, future maintenance will not be needed.
Although the plan reduced maintenance costs, its initial expense must be ignored.
The plan reduced initial costs, so all future maintenance expenses have disappeared.
question.exp: Although...still...保留「雖然……但仍……」的讓步關係；initial costs是初期成本，future maintenance expenses是後續維護費用。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Choose the best translation of「學生完成安全訓練後，才可以使用實驗室。」
question.correct: Students may not use the laboratory until they have completed safety training.
wrong: Students may use the laboratory before completing safety training.
Students must stop using the laboratory once they have completed safety training.
Students need not complete safety training if the laboratory is available.
question.exp: Not...until正確表達「直到……才」，並維持完成安全訓練為開始使用實驗室之前提的意思。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Choose the best translation of「如果市政府去年有提前通知居民，施工造成的不便或許就能減少。」
question.correct: If the city government had notified residents earlier last year, the disruption caused by construction might have been reduced.
wrong: If the city government will notify residents last year, construction is reduced.
Because the city government notified residents last year, construction caused no disruption.
If residents had notified the city government last year, the construction would have been canceled.
question.exp: 針對去年未實現的假設，if子句採had+過去分詞，主要子句採might have+過去分詞；需保留通知方向與可能減少不便，而非保證取消施工。
question.subject: 英文
